visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young East Asian male with short black hair sits on a black leather sofa. He wears a bulky, quilted brown jacket over a light grey shirt and tan khaki trousers. His right hand holds a small item to his lips while his left hand rests on a remote control. The couch features a pink patterned cloth and a blue-and-white striped pillow. (2) The male character lies in a wooden bed frame with a striped mattress. He is wrapped in a thick grey duvet, reaching up to his chest. He holds a white tissue against his nose with both hands, repeatedly wiping his nostrils. A window with white horizontal slats and wooden framing provides bright natural light from behind. (3) The man stands in a kitchen environment, wearing the same brown jacket. He holds a small white plate with eggs in his left hand and shakes a green spice container with his right. He abruptly closes his eyes, tilts his head forward, and performs a sneezing motion while shaking the seasonings. Modern kitchen tiles and a stove are visible.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic representation of the common cultural experience where parents, specifically mothers, obsessively worry about their children's well-being during winter holidays. By showing the protagonist in various domestic settings being constantly followed by his mother's concerned voice-over, the content creates a humorous and relatable narrative for young adults.
